prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
For a **larger remodel**, **American Construction Inc.** looks like a solid option to contact: it says it has served Joplin since 1993, handles remodeling and other general-contracting work, is licensed, bonded, and insured, and offers a one-year labor warranty. Call **(417) 781-6811**. [Company website](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com/)

For **kitchen or bathroom renovations, flooring, or custom carpentry**, **GRC General Construction** is another candidate. BBB lists it as accredited with an A+ rating and describes those services. Call **(417) 499-7424**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/remodel-contractors/grc-general-construction-0734-1000049263)

For **smaller repairs or handyman work**, **Shere’s Handyman & Construction** advertises repair and remodeling services and says it is licensed, insured, and bonded. [Website](https://sheresconstruction.com/)

These are starting points, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least three written bids, verify current insurance and any required local credentials, ask for recent references and similar-project photos, and agree in writing on scope, payment schedule, timeline, and warranty.
